info.title: MemberID management API
info.description: Installation-wide operator interface on a separate private listener. This is not OIDC, OAuth, or SCIM. JSON request objects require exact, unique field names. See management-api.md for lifecycle and deployment requirements.

post.description: Atomically creates a new organization, initial independent Member, and binding to an existing active verified phone factor. Does not grant application roles.

200.description: Original accepted enrollment receipt, including exact replays.

put.description: Verifies DingTalk authorization and configures or rotates application credentials with an expected revision. An ambiguous organization returns 409.

put.description: Create an immutable update using a caller-generated UUID. Exact retries return the original receipt without reapplying the change. Reusing an accepted UUID with another target or change returns 409.

post.summary: Query candidate Members with at least one eligible binding
post.description: One current stored snapshot, constrained to the requested organization and 1 through 100 unique Member IDs. Missing, foreign, or ineligible identities are omitted. This does not authenticate a specific factor or grant application permissions.
Revision must be zero. Duplicate registration or entity IDs return 409.

put.description: Body id must match the path. Positive current revision required. Set enabled=false to disable. Stale revisions and retired registrations return 409; ownership and entity ID are immutable.

post.description: Irreversible retirement preserves entity ID and subject mappings. Current revision required. Audit and change commit atomically.

managementBearer.description: Random installation management credential. OIDC tokens and client secrets are not accepted.

Error.description: 400 invalid request; 401 missing or invalid management credential; 403 browser access denied or ineligible factor; 404 record not found; 409 identifier, binding, email uniqueness or revision conflict; 415 JSON required; 422 candidate Member identifier collision; 500 internal error; 503 provider verification unavailable. Unknown routes and unsupported methods may use ordinary HTTP errors.

OrganizationID.description: org_system is reserved for existing lookups; creation and enrollment reject it.

MemberID.description: mbr_root is reserved for the Member created by installation bootstrap.

bindingId.description: Canonicalized to lowercase before idempotency comparison.

clientSecret.description: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters or leading/trailing whitespace.

expectedRevision.description: 0 for initial configuration; current revision for rotation.

eligibleMemberIds.description: Requested eligible Member IDs in ascending identifier order; an empty array when none qualify.

displayName.description: Optional display name; empty or omitted uses the registration ID.

acsUrl.description: One exact HTTPS HTTP-POST recipient; no wildcard or fragment.

signingCertificates.description: PEM public RSA certificates; at least one unless unsigned requests are explicitly allowed.

revision.description: Zero on creation; the current positive revision on replacement.

nameIdFormat.description: Fixed once any mapping exists. Omission selects persistent; preserve the inspected value on replacement.

SAMLServiceProviderInput.description: Complete replacement; only the route selects ownership. Request size is limited to 32 KiB. Binding is fixed to Redirect input and POST output. NameID format cannot change once allocated.
